name: Binary Radiance Fields
definition: A radiance field representation that uses binary feature grids (parameters constrained to +1 or -1) to significantly reduce storage overhead compared to real-valued floating-point grids, while maintaining reconstruction quality via a 2D-3D hybrid multi-resolution architecture.
summary: Binary Radiance Fields is a storage-efficient radiance field representation that constrains feature grid parameters to binary values during training, using a 2D-3D hybrid grid to mitigate hash collisions while maintaining high reconstruction fidelity.
